description: This file defines the Goteo\Core\Redirection class, which extends the Exception class to facilitate HTTP redirection with temporary and permanent status codes. It manages redirection URLs and provides methods to construct redirection exceptions.

classes.name: Redirection
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling HTTP redirection with support for both temporary and permanent redirects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Redirection object with a URL and optional status code (default is 302).

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Returns the URL to which the redirection points.
